description:
## Functional specifications and files
Audit all changed consumers end-to-end; consolidate duplicate tests while retaining scenario/permission/race assertions. Update ingestion/BO contracts and PR pending PR2/3 boundaries. Reconcile legacy epic and PR2 contradictory plan references without claiming implementation there.
Files/owners: Existing source/lifecycle/query/LiveView tests, docs/services/ingestion.md, docs/bo-components.md only relevant sections, Beadwork notes.
## Tests to add before implementation
Focused full label/query/source lifecycle suite; existing E2E as required; migration fresh and upgrade paths; no new feature E2E before UX gate. Audit queries and UI do not expose inherited labels from unauthorized sources.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Reuse verification across operations; docs-only portions not applicable. No second implementation for bulk, query or UI; test real Actions/Repo/Events, external edges only mocked.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.

comments.text: Independent test reuse audit: extend existing value/invalid rollback/catalog/query tests. Consolidate LabelsLive selection styling test into select-all test preserving every toolbar/checkbox/row/modal assertion; keep separate editor Cancel-new vs Cancel-existing and distinct single/bulk/revoked/deletion/lifecycle transactions. Reuse LabelFixtures; no blanket deduplication across layers. Fresh upstream/main is 12 commits ahead; merge preview reports only assets/css/styles.css conflict. Integrate upstream before final review/coverage if still needed, preserve semantic changes, no force push; validation must cover final merged tree.

Final consolidation must remove temporary Label.targets projection/targets input alias and legacy free-text DSM rendering once all consumers use typed resources/value_config. User clarified labeling is unreleased: no old-value migration or backward-compatibility infrastructure needed. Preserve unrelated existing source/local permission behavior and existing authorization/concurrency assertions. Verify no old assignment schemas/tables or free-text bulk/editor paths remain in production consumers.

Cleanup audit after typed UI integration: virtual Label.targets and input targets alias remain temporary and have no current catalog/editor consumer. The old :label_value_suggestions route/delegate/ResourceLabels functions now have only test consumers in inspected label UI/domain paths; they retain permission/escaping/limit cases. Decide removal vs justified retained public typed usage API after full reference audit; do not silently delete security coverage or introduce another suggestion engine. Prefer moving reusable assertions to existing value-usage tests if obsolete route removal is within approved typed-contract scope.

Final scope consolidation removes unused batch source APIs and reconciles existing typed-label documentation. Existing suggestion API/test coverage retained; no new parallel UI or inheritance API shipped. Source Save reuses existing EditResourceLabels Action, single Channels source context Event, canonical Document identity and checked ExternalPermissions projection.
